title: RETRIS
description:
A classic formula with new mind breaking twists.RelearnExperience the thrill of being a beginner again and reach for mastery.RecombinedRetro glitch aesthetics and mechanics.Features include:• "Broken" pieces with a whole new set of interesting possibilities and challenges. 

• Gain "Pills" to remove any piece that you don't want.

• "Corruption Trail": Speed up any piece to be able to remove all lines at once.

• Puzzle mode with over 50 handcrafted puzzles that teaches new techniques.

• Choose between 3 original musical themes.

• Cat mascot!
description_short: A fresh take on the the falling block puzzle genre. Embrace imperfection with glitches and broken pieces to overcome this new challenge. Chase high scores or learn new techniques in a puzzle mode with over 50 handcrafted puzzles.
